run_get_thermo: run get_thermo to read a thermo log file and return simulation time and total energy arrays
run_get_nve_md_data: run get_nve_md_data to load MD22 or TM23 dataset structures paired with their target temperatures
create_NVEMDRunner: create an NVEMDRunner instance with an ASE calculator, input data, timestep, steps, and save frequency
run_NVEMDRunner_calculate: run NVEMDRunner calculate to relax a structure with LBFGS then perform NVE molecular dynamics simulation
run_NVEMDRunner_write_results: run NVEMDRunner write_results to read and validate thermo log files after molecular dynamics simulation
